about: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, development, production, and distribution of crude oil, natural gas, and value-added products in India and internationally. It operates through Exploration and Production, Refining & Marketing, and Petrochemicals segments.
